Cultural Function: Forms abstract nouns denoting reflexive moral disposition, humility, pride, hedonism, or physical condition.
Twi Exemplars: ahobraseɛ (humility), ahomasoɔ (arrogance/hubris), ahododoɔ (vanity/ostentation), ahopɛ (hedonism/narcissism), ahotew (spiritual purity), ahoɔyaw (bitter envy)

Cultural Function: Reflects cognitive compliance, mental fortitude, or metaphysical destiny.
Twi Exemplars: ti-ɛden (stubbornness/obstinacy), tiripa (good destiny/fortune), tibɔne (ill-fated head), tiri-muden (heartlessness/stubborn hardness)

Semantic Domain: Face / Social Front / Public Honor / Shame
Cultural Function: Encodes face culture, public dignity, social esteem, disgrace, and public demeanor.
Twi Exemplars: animuonyam (honor/glory/radiance), animtia (disgrace/insult), anim-guaseɛ (ignominy/total disgrace), anim-ha (unwelcoming demeanour), anidaho (sober dignity)

Cultural Function: Encodes receptivity to communal advice, compliance with hierarchy, and retributive discipline.
Twi Exemplars: asoɔden (disobedience/hard ears), asoɔmerekɛseɛ (attentive compliance), asotwe (sanction/ear-pulling punishment)

Cultural Function: Denotes speech style, diplomatic register, rhetorical etiquette, and verbal conflict de-escalation.
Twi Exemplars: kasakoa (euphemism/circumlocution), kasaprɔprɔ (raw/blunt offensive speech), kasadwini (poetic rhetoric), kasafua (diplomatic utterance), kasa bɔkɔɔ (temperate gentle speech)

Cultural Function: Denotes deep visceral compassion, benevolence, or internal cruelty.
Twi Exemplars: ayamye (generosity/benevolence), ayamhyehyeɛ (deep visceral empathy), ayam-onwono (stinginess/bitterness of heart)
